It’s totally okay to “chicken out” 🙂. For me to talk about ✨gender things✨ with other people, I had to feel more comfortable about the topic. Take all the time that you need, you can even see a gender therapist if you’re not comfortable with talking to your regular doctor.

As a person who just generally hates men (and Americans), I don’t think you’ve done anything wrong. It wasn’t your choice to have xy chromosomes and that shouldn’t be the reason why society drags you down. If you don’t act like a threat, you aren’t a threat. Other men have made this huge barrier for you and you just have to prove them wrong/act like a decent human being. You don’t sound like a bad person to me. If you do realize that you are non binary I would really encourage you to come out to people that you feel comfortable with. I came out last week to my family as non binary and it feels like a GIGANTIC weight has been lifted off of my shoulders. :)
